name: Do I need to remove my old flooring before new tile can be installed?
description: Generally, old flooring should be removed to ensure a stable, even subfloor for new tile. Hometelligent Inc. inspects to determine the best approach.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to remove my old flooring before new tile can be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, yes, existing flooring should be removed before installing new tile. Installing tile over old flooring can lead to an uneven surface, compromised adhesion, and potential issues with door clearances. Subfloor integrity is crucial for a successful tile installation. However, in certain situations, such as installing tile over very stable, well-adhered vinyl or linoleum, it might be possible to lay a new backer board directly on top, though this is less common. Hometelligent Inc. always recommends a thorough subfloor inspection in your Dublin property to determine the best approach.
